payload.text: Two rules for cc's candidates (vc, 19 Oct). Each candidate lives only in cc's own worktree under ~/Devel/scratch/utilz-cc/, detached at its base, .githooks/*.intent copied in: never in the primary, which is live for hv's menu and shared with peers' path commits, and never in the session scratchpad, which the reboot of 12:23:56Z emptied with cc's five worktrees in it. The primary takes the patch at each landing. Every START says light or heavy: light builds nothing, starts no GUI or daemon, binds no port and writes no state another run reads; any whole suite, and any build, is heavy.
